name: 79720 · Big Spring, TX
findings: ZIP 79720 (Big Spring) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79720 (Big Spring) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
